label: Нести / Носить
description: A 10-sentence card contrasting нести (one trip, now) with носить (habitual/around; also 'to wear').

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: One trip now. Несу is determinate, the first-person form of нести. It names a single carrying act in progress toward one goal, домой, which is the classic determinate trigger.
Strategic focus: Wearing habit. Носит is indeterminate, third-person of носить, here in its 'to wear' sense. The adverb всегда marks a constant habit, which selects the indeterminate member.

Strategic focus: One trip now. Несёт is determinate, third-person of нести. The scene shows one carrying act unfolding before our eyes, a single direction toward the table, so the determinate form fits.
Strategic focus: Daily round-trips. Носит is indeterminate, third-person of носить. Каждый день signals repeated, multidirectional delivery rounds, the core indeterminate trigger.

missions.phrase: Сейчас я несу ребёнка на руках.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Minimal pair, now. Несу is determinate; сейчас pins the carrying to this moment and one direction. Compare with носить, which would mean carrying the child around habitually.

missions.phrase: Я часто ношу ребёнка на руках.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Minimal pair, habit. Ношу is indeterminate, first-person of носить. Часто marks a repeated habit with no single direction, the mirror of the determinate несу in the previous scene.

missions.phrase: Вчера он нёс цветы своей маме.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: One past trip. Нёс is the determinate masculine past of нести. It describes one directed carrying act on a specific occasion, вчера, so the determinate past is correct.

missions.phrase: В детстве он носил длинные волосы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past wearing habit. Носил is the indeterminate masculine past of носить in its 'to wear' sense. The childhood span describes a lasting habitual state, which selects the indeterminate form.
Strategic focus: One trip now. Несёшь is determinate, second-person of нести. The question куда asks about one destination of a carrying act in progress, a determinate context.

Strategic focus: Seasonal wearing. Носим is indeterminate, first-person plural of носить, again the 'to wear' sense. The recurring winter habit, with no single trip, calls for the indeterminate member.
